blocks.title: Reaction mechanism
blocks.text: Reaction mechanism is baat ki tafseeli, qadam ba qadam wazahat hai ke kimiyai reaction molecular satah par products dene ke liye kaise hoti hai. Balanced muadle ke bar-aks, jo sirf reactants aur products dikhata hai, yeh woh alag alag elementary qadam zahir karta hai jo asal mein hote hain, har ek bond ke tootne ya banne jaisa ek molecular waqia.

Bohat si reactions ek ke bajaye qadmon ke silsile se chalti hain. Har qadam elementary reaction hai jo seedhe atoms, ions ya molecules ke takrane se hoti hai, aur elementary qadam mein reactant molecules ki tadaad us ki molecularity hai. Unimolecular qadam mein ek reactant molecule hota hai, jaise N2O5 ka NO2 + NO3 mein tootna; bimolecular mein do, jaise CO + NO3 se NO2 + CO2 ya NO + O3 se NO2 + O2; termolecular qadam mein teen molecules ek saath hote hain aur yeh kamyab hai, jaise stratosphere ya smog mein 2O2 + O se O3 + O2. Intermediates kam-umr species (ions ya free radicals) hain jo ek qadam mein banti aur baad ke qadam mein kharch hoti hain; woh kul muadle mein nahi aatin kyunke mustahkam products nahi.

Bohat se mechanisms mein ek qadam baqi se kahin sust hota hai: rate-determining step, jo kul rate par qaboo rakhta hai kyunke yeh reaction ke aage barhne ki raftar ko mehdood karta hai. Kul muadla sab qadmon ka kul nateeja hai. Rate-determining step ke baad ka koi qadam rate par asar nahi karta, to us ke baad hissa lene wali species rate expression mein nahi aatin, jabke rate-determining step ke sab reactants rate muadle mein aate hain. Kyunke rate-determining step kul rate ko mehdood karta hai, order us se nikala ja sakta hai.

2NO(g) + 2H2(g) se 2H2O(g) + N2(g) ke liye chhe experiments (Table 7.3) dikhate hain ke [NO] mustaqil rakh kar [H2] dugna karne se rate dugni aur tigna karne se tigni hoti hai, to rate [H2] ke mutanasib hai; [H2] mustaqil rakh kar [NO] dugna karne se rate chaar se aur tigna karne se nau se zarb hoti hai, to rate [NO]^2 ke mutanasib hai. Rate muadla rate = k [H2][NO]^2 hai, teesra order, aur yeh balanced muadle se nahi nikala ja sakta. Mumkin do-qadmi mechanism: qadam 1 (sust, rate-determining) 2NO + H2 se N2 + H2O2; qadam 2 (tez) H2O2 + H2 se 2H2O. 2NO2(g) + F2(g) se 2NO2F(g) ke liye dekhi gai rate law rate = k [NO2][F2] hai, har ek mein pehla order aur kul doosra; maqbool mechanism qadam 1 (sust) NO2 + F2 se NO2F + F, rate = k1 [NO2][F2], aur qadam 2 (tez) NO2 + F se NO2F. Pehla qadam sust hai aur rate tai karta hai, dekhi gai rate expression ke mutabiq; tez doosra qadam rate par asar nahi karta kyunke fluorine atoms bante hi NO2 se react kar jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Tezabi hydrogen peroxide iodide se react karta hai, H2O2 + 2H+ + 2I- se 2H2O + I2, rate = k [H2O2][I-] ke saath. Tajweez-kardah mechanism: H2O2 + I- se H2O + IO- (sust); H+ + IO- se HIO (tez); HIO + H+ + I- se I2 + H2O (tez). Wazahat karein ke yeh rate muadle se kyun mutabiq hai, aur intermediates ke naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Sust pehla qadam rate-determining hai, aur us mein ek H2O2 aur ek I- hain, to rate har ek mein pehle order ki aur H+ se azad hai, bilkul dekhi gai rate = k [H2O2][I-]. Hydrogen ions aur doosra iodide sirf baad ke tez qadmon mein aate hain, to woh rate law mein nahi. IO- aur HIO intermediates hain, ek qadam mein bante aur agle mein kharch; qadam jama karne se kul muadla milta hai.

items: Mechanism elementary qadmon ka silsila hai; molecularity ek qadam ke molecules ki tadaad (uni-, bi-, termolecular); intermediates bante aur kharch hote hain aur kul muadle mein kabhi nahi aate.

Sab se sust qadam rate-determining hai aur us ke reactants rate law banate hain: 2NO + H2 sust rate = k [H2][NO]^2 deta hai; NO2 + F2 sust rate = k [NO2][F2]; baad ke tez qadam rate par asar nahi karte.
